title: Summarize subcommand for issues
description: Add a summarize subcommand to kbs that makes sequential LLM calls to summarize issue description, comment history, current state, and title, saving as a summary comment.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Feature: Issue summarization
  Scenario: Running the summarize subcommand
    Given an issue with multiple comments and descriptions
    And a configured LLM provider
    When I run the summarize subcommand for the issue
    Then the system makes 4 sequential LLM calls in the same conversation session
    And a new comment of type "summary" is appended to the issue with the results
